# Pulsoid script functions

Functions for C# (`Cb.Call`) and Python (`cb.call`). See [Script functions](index.md) for how to use them.

## pulsoid.isConnected

Checks whether Cuebot is connected to Pulsoid (heart rate) right now.

**Gives back:** true while connected, otherwise false.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("pulsoid.isConnected");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.call("pulsoid.isConnected")
    ```
